tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs and the editor canvas. Sits on surface-50.

tokens.name: surface-50
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Subtle fills: hovered rows, selected nav items, read-only fields, skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards, inputs at rest, table rules and dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders on hover and control outlines that carry meaning (3:1 on surface-0).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface-0, surface-50 and surface-100.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, helper text, timestamps and metadata on surface-0, surface-50 and surface-100.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, the active nav marker and focus rings. The one colour the product is known by.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected states, the active step in a stepper and brand badges. Pair with brand-ink text.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-tint.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-hover fills.

tokens.name: aurora-cyan
tokens.usage: First stop of the aurora glow behind AI actions and generating states. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: aurora-sky
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the aurora glow. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: aurora-peach
tokens.usage: Last stop of the aurora glow; also the warm accent in the cover. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Text and icons for Approved and Published states, on success-tint or surface-0.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background of Approved and Published badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Text and icons for Needs review and critic flags, on warning-tint or surface-0.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of Needs review badges and critic notes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons for errors, failed publishes and destructive actions, on danger-tint or surface-0.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of error badges and failed-publish banners.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty states and the dashboard greeting. One per screen at most.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Field groups, table headers, list item titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: All running text, inputs and post previews.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, badges and nav section labels.

tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding, list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gaps between fields; mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding and gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top padding and empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals, the AI generate panel and cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, toggles and avatar discs.

tokens.usage: Cards and panels at rest on surface-50.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, menus and modals.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Soft halo outside the 2px brand focus ring.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press and colour changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Panels opening, items fading in, step changes.

tokens.usage: Page-level reveals and the staggered fade-up of a new batch.

tokens.usage: One sweep of the shimmer on text being generated.
